hero.title: Privacy policy
paragraphs: How Tano collects, uses, shares and protects your data.

blocks.html: This Privacy Policy describes Our policies and procedures on the collection, use and disclosure of Your information when You use the Service and tells You about Your privacy rights and how the law protects You.
We use Your Personal data to provide and improve the Service. By using the Service, You agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this Privacy Policy.

The words of which the initial letter is capitalized have meanings defined under the following conditions. The following definitions shall have the same meaning regardless of whether they appear in singular or in plural.
For the purposes of this Privacy Policy:

items: Account — A unique account created for You to access our Service or parts of our Service.

Affiliate — An entity that controls, is controlled by or is under common control with a party, where "control" means ownership of 50% or more of the shares, equity interest or other securities entitled to vote for election of directors or other managing authority.
Application — Refers to Tano, the software program provided by the Company.
Company — Tano AI Ltd, 74 Margravine Gardens, London, England, W6 8RJ.
Cookies — Small files placed on Your computer, mobile device or any other device by a website, containing details of Your browsing history on that website among its many uses.
Country — United Kingdom.
Device — Any device that can access the Service such as a computer, a cellphone or a digital tablet.
Personal Data — Any information that relates to an identified or identifiable individual.
Service — Refers to the Application or the Website or both.
Service Provider — Any natural or legal person who processes the data on behalf of the Company.
Third-party Social Media Service — Any website or social network website through which a User can log in or create an account to use the Service.
Usage Data — Data collected automatically, either generated by the use of the Service or from the Service infrastructure itself.
Website — Tano, accessible from https://www.tano.ai and https://app.tano.ai, including any subdomains.
You — The individual accessing or using the Service, or the company, or other legal entity on behalf of which such individual is accessing or using the Service.

blocks.html: While using Our Service, We may ask You to provide Us with certain personally identifiable information that can be used to contact or identify You. This may include:

items: Email address
First name and last name
Phone number
Address, State, Province, ZIP/Postal code, City
Usage Data

blocks.html: Usage Data is collected automatically when using the Service. It may include information such as Your Device's Internet Protocol address, browser type, browser version, pages visited, time and date of visits, time spent on pages, unique device identifiers and other diagnostic data. When accessing the Service through a mobile device, We may collect additional information including device type, ID, IP address, operating system, browser type, and other diagnostic data.

sections.heading: Information from third-party social media services

blocks.html: The Company allows You to create an account and log in through:

items: Facebook
Instagram
Twitter
LinkedIn

blocks.html: We use Cookies and similar technologies, including pixels and web beacons, to understand how the Website is used and to improve our marketing. We group them as follows:

items: Strictly necessary: needed for the Website to work. These cannot be switched off.
Analytics: help us understand which pages are visited and how the Website performs.
Marketing and visitor identification: help us understand which businesses visit the Website, so we can follow up with relevant information about our Service.

blocks.html: We only set analytics and marketing Cookies once You have given consent through our cookie banner. You can change or withdraw Your consent at any time through the “Cookie settings” link in the footer of the Website.

We use RB2B, a third-party service provider operated by Retention.com, to understand which businesses visit the Website. When You visit, RB2B’s pixel collects information such as Your IP address, browser details, the pages You view and the time of Your visit.

RB2B only runs if You have accepted marketing Cookies. For visitors located in the United States, RB2B may match this information with data it holds to identify Your name, business email address, job title, company and professional profile. For visitors outside the United States, RB2B identifies the company You work for only, and does not create a profile of You as an individual.
We use this information to understand which businesses are interested in Tano and to contact relevant visitors about our Service.

You can opt out of visitor identification at any time by declining marketing Cookies through the “Cookie settings” link in the footer, by visiting https://app.retention.com/optout/, or by emailing privacy@tano.ai. Once You opt out, we will stop contacting You based on Website visits and will delete the data we hold about You within 30 days.
The Company may use Personal Data for:

items: Service provision and maintenance
Account management
Contract performance
Communication
Marketing
Request management
Business transfers
Analysis and improvement

blocks.html: We may share or transfer Your information, including Google user data, in the following situations:

items: With Service Providers — to monitor and analyze the use of our Service, for payment processing, and to contact You.

With Service Providers for visitor identification — including RB2B, which processes Website usage data on our behalf to identify visiting companies and, in the United States only, individual business contacts.
For business transfers — in connection with, or during negotiations of, any merger, sale of Company assets, financing, or acquisition of all or a portion of Our business to another company.
With Affiliates — in which case we will require those affiliates to honor this Privacy Policy.
With business partners — to offer You certain products, services or promotions.
With other users — when You share personal information or otherwise interact in the public areas with other users, such information may be viewed by all users and may be publicly distributed outside.
With Your consent — we may disclose Your personal information for any other purpose with Your consent.

blocks.html: If You are in the United Kingdom or the European Economic Area, we rely on:

items: Consent for analytics and marketing Cookies, and for visitor identification.
Contract where processing is needed to provide the Service You have signed up for.
Legitimate interests for business-to-business communication about our Service, where those interests are not overridden by Your rights.
Legal obligation where we must keep or disclose data by law.

blocks.html: You can withdraw consent, object to processing or ask us to access, correct or delete Your Personal Data at any time by emailing privacy@tano.ai. You also have the right to complain to the Information Commissioner’s Office (ico.org.uk) or Your local data protection authority.
Specifically regarding Google user data obtained through Google Sign-In or other Google APIs:

items: We do not sell, rent, or trade Google user data to third parties.
We only share Google user data with third-party service providers necessary for our Service functionality (such as authentication services, analytics providers, and cloud hosting services).
We do not transfer Google user data to any party except as necessary to provide or improve user-facing features that are visible to You.
Any sharing of Google user data is done in compliance with Google's Limited Use requirements.
We may disclose Google user data if required by law, legal process, or governmental request.

blocks.html: When You connect Your Gmail account to our Service, You authorize our AI agent to access and use Your Gmail account. This includes:

items: Full inbox access — reading, composing, sending, and managing emails on Your behalf.
Autonomous operations — the AI agent may act independently based on Your settings without requiring approval for each action.
Data analysis — analyzing Your email patterns, contacts, and conversations to optimize performance.
Purpose limitation — Gmail data is used only for providing and improving our Service as described in this Privacy Policy.

blocks.html: We retain Personal Data only as long as necessary for the purposes set out in this Privacy Policy, including legal obligations, dispute resolution, and policy enforcement.

Your information may be transferred to and processed in computers located outside your jurisdiction. Where we transfer Personal Data outside the United Kingdom or European Economic Area, including to Service Providers in the United States such as RB2B, we rely on appropriate safeguards such as the UK International Data Transfer Addendum or the EU Standard Contractual Clauses.
While we implement commercially acceptable protection means, no Internet transmission or electronic storage method is 100% secure.
Our Service does not address anyone under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.
Our Service may link to external sites that we don't operate. We recommend reviewing their privacy policies.
We may update this policy and will notify you of significant changes via email and/or website notice.
If You have any questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise Your rights, email privacy@tano.ai or write to Tano AI Ltd, 74 Margravine Gardens, London, England, W6 8RJ.
